source.name: Composite Schedule of Rates Balochistan (BCSR), Volume-I
source.publisher: Planning & Development Department, Government of Balochistan
source.notes: Machine-extracted with pdfplumber from the text PDF (Volume-I). The book prints metric first: unit_as_printed/rate_as_printed are the metric unit and composite rate as printed and rate_pkr is that rate per normalised unit; the British-system rate printed alongside was used to cross-check (5% tolerance, mismatches dropped). Chapter 1 'Carriage' (per-km rates) and percentage-addition rows were omitted, as were rows with units outside the allowed set. Codes are BCSR-<book item no.>-<sub-item markers> (hN = an unnumbered sub-heading, #n = repeated numbering). About 150 rate rows printed without their own sub-item marker under an already-priced line were left out because their description could not be attributed reliably.
